description: Full GLM-5.3 (744B MoE) on four DGX Sparks with KindlingAI's gr8, a from-scratch CUDA inference engine (no vLLM, PyTorch or NCCL at serve time), at tensor parallel 4 over the ConnectX fabric. The weights are KindlingAI's exlr8 release v0.6 at its bit325 width profile (every routed expert at K3, down projections at K4 in 56 layers, about 3.25 bits a routed weight). The KV cache is pure FP8 (native 656-byte MLA latent rows, no INT4 quantisation, BF16 kv_b projections) with a 655,360-token pool, requests up to 655,360 tokens, eight at once and zero-copy shared prefix pages, uncapped exact MoE routing (KL 0 against the uncapped engine, the creator's figure) and DFlash2 plus MTP=2 drafting. The recipe runs gr8's published v1.2.0 image (commit ab2eb95f) with the settings of kindlingai/recipes at 13c24ac4 (glm-5.3/dgx-spark/4x/exlr8-fp8kv-gr8) and a placement wrapper that reads the platform's VONK_* environment and uses the release in place from the read-only model mounts; the DFlash2 drafter is converted for each rank on its first start. Options: the creator's uncapped-exact, balanced or fast MoE preset (MOE_UNION_CAP 0, 48 or 32); DFlash2 or MTP only; the creator's optional 200 GB persistent SSD KV store that keeps chats across an orderly restart. The creator's lowest free memory a box was 6.41 GiB under its stress runs, below the platform's usual 8 GiB margin, so it is tried on idle Sparks first. About 659 GB of model files a box. Each box mounts the width files its manifest reads whole, where the creator's launcher range-fetches only the box's part from Hugging Face. Thinking is always on in GLM 5.3's template: a request that turns it off gets HTTP 400 (the creator's default), and a small max_tokens can end inside the thinking. Licences, for information: the weights are under Z.AI's GLM-5.3 License (KindlingAI's exlr8 additions also CC BY 4.0), the engine and the recipe MIT; IncoAI's DFlash2 drafter is CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
title: GLM 5.3 EXLR8 FP8 KV gr8 four Sparks
